set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols mpls interface [parameter1.explanation: Enables the MPLS protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ldp interface [parameter1].explanation: Enables the LDP protocol on the specified interface.

set protocols ldp targeted-peer [paramet.explanation: Configure the target peer of the LDP protocol.

parameters.name: peer-ip
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the target peer.

set protocols l2circuit neighbor [parame.explanation: Configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) neighbor with the specified IP address (`[parameter1]`) for point-to-point pseudowire connectivity.

interface [parameter2].explanation: This command configures a Layer 2 Circuit (L2Circuit) by specifying a neighbor device (`parameter1`) and associating it with a local interface (`parameter2`) for pseudowire establishment.

virtual-circuit-id [parameter3].explanation: The L2 circuit is equipped with neighbours, interfaces and virtual circuit ID.

encapsulation-type [parameter4].explanation: Configure L2VPN neighbours, interfaces, virtual circuit ID and containment types.

mtu [parameter4].explanation: The command `mtu [parameter4]` sets the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) size for an interface to the value specified by `[parameter4]`.

pseudowire-class [parameter4].explanation: The command `pseudowire-class [parameter4]` in Junos defines a pseudowire template with specific attributes, where `[parameter4]` specifies the class name for configuration.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

family inet address [parameter3].explanation: Configures an IPv4 address (`[parameter3]`) on a logical interface (`unit [parameter2]`) within a physical interface (`[parameter1]`) in Junos OS.

encapsulation [parameter3].explanation: Configure the envelope type of the interface.

set protocols ospf area [parameter1].explanation: This command configures an OSPF area in Junos OS, where `[parameter1]` specifies the area ID, enabling OSPF routing within the defined area.

interface [parameter2].explanation: Configure interfaces in the OSPF area.

set firewall family inet filter [paramet.command: set firewall family inet filter storm-control
set firewall family inet filter [paramet.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from protocol [parameter3].explanation: The command fragment `from protocol [parameter3]` in Junos filters routes or traffic originating from the specified routing protocol identified by `[parameter3]`.

then policer [parameter3].explanation: The command `then policer [parameter3]` applies a traffic policing action using the specified policer `[parameter3]` to control or limit traffic flow based on defined rates.

parameters.name: policer
parameters.explanation: Name of the speed limit policy.
